_help: Edit to change the extra sections. A section with no items stays hidden. Gallery photos go in public/assets/gallery/ and are listed like {"src":"/assets/gallery/pool.jpg","alt":"The pool"}. A schedule time of "@start" uses the event's start time.

schedule.title: Doors open
schedule.note: Have your QR ticket and ID ready.

faq.a: Guests must be 18 or older and may be asked for ID at the door.
Show your QR ticket at the door, on your phone or as a saved image. Each ticket admits its holder once. A Couple ticket admits two people together.

faq.q: I paid but I can't see my ticket.
faq.a: Tap Find my ticket and enter the phone number you paid from plus your M-Pesa code or order number. Still stuck? Use the help button and we'll sort it out.
Tickets are non-refundable unless the event is cancelled or moved.

faq.q: I lost my phone or my QR.
faq.a: Use Find my ticket on any phone with the number you paid from. Staff can also look you up at the door by name or phone number.
